description_ru: Турист звонит в отель и уточняет детали бронирования.
text:
Receptionist: Good morning, Riverside Hotel. How can I help you?
Victor: Hello. I would like to book a room for next weekend, please.
Receptionist: Certainly. Which nights do you need?
Victor: Friday and Saturday. There will be two of us, my wife and me.
Receptionist: I have a double room with a view of the river. It costs ninety pounds a night.
Victor: That sounds lovely. Is breakfast included?
Receptionist: Yes, it is. We serve it from seven until ten. If you prefer to sleep late, you can ask for a tray in your room.
Victor: Excellent. We have never stayed in your city before, so I have a few questions. Is the hotel far from the station?
Receptionist: Not at all. It takes about ten minutes on foot. If you take a taxi, it will cost you around five pounds.
Victor: Good. And is there a place to park? My friend might drive us there.
Receptionist: Yes, we have a small car park behind the hotel, but it is very popular. If you want a space, you should reserve it in advance.
Victor: Then please reserve one for us. Do you need my credit card number?
Receptionist: Only the last four digits for now. You can pay the rest when you arrive.
Victor: Perfect. My name is Victor Warren. That's W-A-R-R-E-N.
Receptionist: Thank you, Mr Warren. I have written everything down. We look forward to welcoming you on Friday.
Victor: Thank you very much. Goodbye!

focus_sounds.tip_ru: Округлите губы в трубочку и быстро раздвиньте их; зубы не касаются нижней губы, иначе получится «в».
Верхние зубы слегка касаются нижней губы, звук звонкий; не оглушайте его в «ф».
Задняя часть языка касается мягкого нёба, звук идёт через нос; не добавляйте «г» в конце.

questions.question: When does Victor want the room?
How much is the room per night?
How far is the hotel from the station?
